description: This source file defines the `AppSearchController` class, which manages search query state, results, recent searches caching, and UI notifications within a Flutter application. It interacts with a content repository and a cache service to perform content searches and cache recent searches.

classes.name: AppSearchController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for managing search state, results, and recent searches in a Flutter app, with dependency injection of repository and cache.

methods.name: AppSearchController
methods.description: Constructor initializing repository, cache, and setting up cache change listener.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Updates the current search query and notifies listeners.

methods.name: _runQuery
methods.description: Performs search using repository, updates results, and manages recent searches cache.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Triggers a search operation, manages loading state, and updates results.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Refreshes search results from cache without modifying recent searches.

methods.name: clearRecent
methods.description: Clears the list of recent searches from cache.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes cache listener and disposes of the controller.
